question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The **passage discusses a past event or belief.**
 
• The appropriate verb tense should indicate a past action or belief.
 
• "**Believed**" fits well as it denotes a past action, aligning with the context.
 
• Other options ("**believes**", "**will believe**", "**could believe**") do not fit the context of describing a past event or belief.
 
• Hence, the correct word for fill in the box no. 3 is **'believe.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.
